plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Biology-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (source file titled 'B BIO-0-1-5_Bachelor of Science with a major in Biology_2022'; printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map, so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Markers printed on the map are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (no prereqs are recorded): the open diamond means 'Prerequisites: Must be completed prior to applying for a major' (printed on the three B CHEM lecture+lab cells and on B BIO 180, B BIO 200 and B BIO 220); the checkmark means 'Milestones' (printed on B BIO 360 and on the Year 3 Winter statistics slot); the open diamond with dot means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core' (printed on the Year 1 A&H and SSc slots). The map also prints competitive-applicant guidance (3.0 grade in each prerequisite, cumulative GPA of 3.0, a positive grade trend), disclosed here and not encoded. Five printed cells combine a lecture and its lab in one 5-credit slot and are folded into the lecture entry with the combination disclosed on the course title: 'B CHEM 143 + 144', 'B CHEM 153 + 154' and 'B CHEM 163 + 164' (Year 1) and 'B PHYS 114 + 117' and 'B PHYS 115 + 118' (Year 3). Printed notes under the year blocks are disclosed, not encoded: 'BCHEM 153 + 154 is a prerequisite of BBIO 200 but may be taken concurrently'; 'BBIO 180, 200, 220 are prerequisites for most 300- and 400-level BBIO coursework. Scientific Writing (BST 301) is recommended for Additional Writing requirement, but any W course can be used. In SPR quarters only, BBIO 380 (cell biology) is a W course'; and 'Statistics (BMATH 215 or STMATH 341) is a prerequisite for most Investigative Biology work', with a pointer to the Biology course-descriptions website for elective prerequisites. The Year 3 Winter statistics slot prints 'STMATH 341/B MATH/BIS/BHLTH 215 STATISTICS requirement (see degree audit)' and is recorded as a choice slot with exactly those four printed options. Generic slots (A&H, SSc, Diversity course, Minor Coursework/General Elective, Biology Core Course or Upper Division Elective, and the 'or minor coursework' variant) are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots.
